Foreign investment in print media
*81. SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
 Will the Minister of  INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have now
settled the issue of foreign investment/
participation in the print media;
(b) whether it is a fact that at present
foreign news agencies are only allowed to
distribute news within the country through
an Indian news agency owned and managed
by Indians;
(c) if so, whether his Ministry is
considering a review of the existing policy
for operation of foreign news agencies in
the country; and
(d) if so, the decisions taken in this
regard?
Inland Water transport system
*82. MISS MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
 Will the Minister of shipping be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal of introducing inland water
transport system in all cities that have some
river running through it;
(b) whether Government plans to offer
inland water transport as an economical
transport service to the people; and
(c) if so, by when such transportation
system is likely to be introduced in all cities
that have rivers?
Financial assistance to NGOs and
various organisations
*83. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of SOCIAL
JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of financial assistance
granted to various voluntary organisations
and NGOs functioning at present in
different parts of the country during the last
three years, NGO-wise/State-wise;
(b) whether some proposals received
from the State of Assam for providing grants
to NGOs are pending with Government;
(d) the steps being taken by Government

2
WIN2\SESSION\7413RS 2
to clear all the pending proposals for
providing financial assistance to NGOs in
the State of Assam?
Health care in India
*84. SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHWAR:
SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
 Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that participants at
the Pravasi Bharatiya Divas celebrations
held in January, 2003 have expressed
disappointment at the State of health care in
India;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether a large number of delegates
have recommended that the state of health
care be improved through modern and state
of the art technology available in the world;
and
(d) if so, the steps Government propose
to take on the suggestions made by the
delegates at the above Conference?
PHCs in rural areas
*85. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether only one in ten villages have
a Primary Health Centre in the country; and
(b) if so, the measures proposed to be
taken to open more Primary Health Centres,
Sub-Centres, etc. in rural areas?
Pending cases in various courts
*†86. SHRI GAYA SINGH: Will the
Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of cases pending in
various courts of the country; and
(b) the steps being taken for disposal of
such cases?
Target set for earnings of
Doordarshan
*†87.SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN":
 Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have set any
target in order to increase the earnings of
doordarshan during the year 2003-2004;
(b) if so, the targeted amount;
(c) whether Government have fixed any
target amount for the financial year 2002-
2003;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the total earnings of Doordarshan
during first nine months of the financial year
2003-2004?
Welfare Schemes in Himachal
*88. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of different welfare
schemes formulated and implemented in
Himachal Pradesh during the last three
years; and
(b) the details of financial assistance
allocated, released and actually spent for the
said purpose in the State during the above
period?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Schemes for development of STs
*†89.SHRIMOOLCHAND MEENA:
SHRIMATI SAROJ DUBEY:
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the names of on-going schemes in
the country for the development of
scheduled tribes along with the amount
spent on these schemes during the last three
years, State-wise;
(b) whether Government have received
any information regarding misuse of funds
meant for the development schemes for
scheduled tribes; and
(c) if so, the names of the States where
such funds have been misused?

Trade treaty with SAARC Countries
472. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India has signed a trade treaty
with SAARC members;
(b) if so, the highlights of the treaty;
(c) whether multi-nationals operating in
these SAARC countries are likely to take
undue advantages of concessional duty
facility to flood Indian market with their
goods especially food items; and
(d) in what maner Government propose
to tackle this problem?
Setting up of New Export Promotion
Council
473. SHRI R.P. GOENKA:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a proposal has
been formulated to set up a new Export
Promotion Council (EPC) exclusively for
the export-oriented units (EOUs) and the
units located at SEZz and EPSs;
(b) if so, the details of the proposal and
the specific role contemplated for the new
Council and the advantages sought to be
achieved, representing exporters from the
EOUs segment; and
(c) the present number of export-oriented
units functioning int he country and the total
value and volume of exports, as percentage
of the total exports of the country generated
by them?
Export of iron-ore
†474. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the iron-ore is being
exported;
(b) if so, the name of the countries to
which export has been made during the last
three years along with the quantum thereof;
(c) the number of companies including
MMTC indulged in exports and exports
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

WIN2\SESSION\7415RS 2
made by them in terms of quantum and
amount; and
(d) the policy formulated by Government
in this regard for the forth coming financial
year along with the details of its guidelines?
Applications pending for patent
registration
475. DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of applications received
by Patent Office, Chennai for registration
of patents of new inventions emanated from
Karnataka for the last three years;
(b) whether there is any proposal to open
a Patent Office in Bangalore to help the
entrepreneurs, industrialists, scientists and
technologists to register patents without
much delay; and
(c) if so, by when such Patent Office is
likely to be set up in Bangalore?
Increase in export
†476. SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that export from
the country has been on the increase
constantly;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that this
export is increasing to the countries which
are traditional importers of Indian goods;
(c) if so, the names of countries to which
export has increased along with the
percentage increase;
(d) the names of such new countries to
which export have been made during the
last three years; and
(e) the percentage of average annual
export to these countries during the said
period?
Increased rate of industrial production
†477. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a target for
increased rate of industrial production in
the current year has been fixed;
(b) if so, the target so fixed; and
(c) what has been the increased rate of
industrial production in the first nine months
of current financial year?
FDI in industrial sector
478. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to allow Foreign Direct Investment
in the Industrial Sector;
(b) if so, the areas in which FDI is likely
to be introduced along with the details
thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

3
WIN2\SESSION\7415RS 3
Tea plantation
479. SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government would take
steps to open the work relating to the tea
plantation which is closed; and
(b) the steps Government intend to take
to ensure employment to the tea estate
workers and to disburse the arrears of
wages, bonus and other benefits?
